title: interdent.com
description: Status: Leaked | Revenue: $343M | 850GB Interdent is a dentist-led practice support organization that provides technology, mentorship, and operational expertise to dental practices. The company aims to help dental teams grow and deliver exceptional care through comprehensive business and administrative support. With a network of over 175 supported dental offices, Interdent focuses on fostering professional growth and collaboration among its affiliated practitioners. Their commitment to quality care and patient satisfaction makes them a trusted partner in lifelong oral healthcare.
